learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the necessary level to acquire the rest of the degree's competences, including notions of the latest advances.
Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

The ability to analyze complex products, processes and systems in their field of study; choose and apply relevant established analytical, computational and experimental methods and correctly interpret the results of said analyses.

The ability to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; choose and apply appropriate established analytical, computational and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial constraints.

Ability to project, design and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes and systems in their specialty, that meet established requirements, including awareness of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial aspects; as well as selecting and applying appropriate project methods.
Project ability using advanced knowledge from their engineering specialty.

Ability to conduct bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other information sources, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Ability and skill to design and carry out experimental research, interpret results and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project and research and their limitations in the scope of their specialty.
Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in the scope of their specialty.
Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers as well as people from other disciplines.
Ability to recognize the need for continuous self-learning and to undertake this activity throughout their professional life independently.
Ability to stay up-to-date with scientific and technological developments.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each of them, and making correct use of language, in writing.

teaching_methods: Development, writing, and presentation of reports, audiovisual material related to projects/POPBLs, performed individually or in teams
Individual study and work, tests, exams, and/or checkpoints
Professor's presentation in the classroom, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects
Practical work in workshops and/or laboratories, performed individually or in teams
